canonical_statement: For the arithmetic data and normalization of a selected Gross-Zagier source variant, the first derivative at the central point of the associated Rankin or elliptic-curve L-series equals its explicit normalization factor times the Neron-Tate height or height pairing of the associated Heegner point or divisor.
domain_and_universes: Expected to quantify over arithmetic fields, modular elliptic-curve or modular-form data, and Heegner data; exact domains and universes are deferred because choosing them before the source variant would invent mathematics.
quantifiers: modular elliptic curve or weight-two newform data
imaginary quadratic field and embedding/order data
Heegner hypotheses and selected normalization convention
hypotheses: the conductor/discriminant conditions of the selected source theorem
the Heegner splitting hypothesis at relevant primes
the analytic continuation and normalization used to define the central derivative
conclusion: An exact equality between the selected central L-derivative and an explicit factor times the selected Neron-Tate height expression.
